assay: bulk RNA-seq (BGI DNBseq, 100 bp PE), human vastus lateralis; STAR 2.7.3a + RSEM (S4.9.1.p1)
design: parallel-group randomized trial (S2.1.p1, S4.5.p1, S4.6.p1): healthy men allocated to SIE or MICE; RNA-seq on 12 per group (Fig. 1D: n = 12 per group; S4.9.1.p1: 72 samples = 24 participants x 3 timepoints) at rest (pre), early recovery (+3 h from start of exercise) and late recovery (+24 h) (S2.2.p1)
repeated_measure_unit: participant (3 biopsies per participant; participants nested within exercise group)
sample_inclusion: all 72 RNA-seq samples (24 participants x 3 timepoints); no exclusions stated
primary_estimand: within-group exercise response at +3 h and +24 h vs rest, for MICE and SIE separately (S2.2.p2, Fig. 1E), and the between-group difference in exercise response (time x group interaction) at +3 h and +24 h (S2.3.p1)
planned_contrasts: SIE vs MICE difference in response at +3h (S2.3.p1; paper: 207 transcripts, 116 larger up in SIE, 91 larger up in MICE)
SIE vs MICE difference in response at +24h (S2.3.p1; paper: 16 transcripts)
normalization: not stated beyond 'following previously published guidelines' (S4.9.1.p1); 13,295 transcripts detected across samples (S2.2.p1) implies a low-expression filter
paper_method: limma and DESeq2 on RSEM read counts in R (S4.9.1.p1); which package produced which count is not stated; fGSEA for the mitostress gene set

paper_results.ORA: SIE-larger-up genes at 3 h enriched for protein folding / UPR terms (Fig. 2B)
paper_results.GSEA: mitostress set enriched only after SIE (NES 1.50, FDR < 0.01)
